status: ②a で宣言。②a の技術受理の後、②b で、この組を変えずに一度だけ走らせる。③はこの組を引き継いで変えない。v0.2 は、合成の seed を一度も走らせていない段階で、#177 のレビューの静的な論理の欠陥を直した改訂

evaluation.q_meaning: operational feasibility floor (10 of 50 windows end in a choice); not a guarantee of estimation precision
evaluation.body_feasible: in the same body: decided / windows >= q AND A1_occurred AND A2_occurred
evaluation.individual_feasible: both paired bodies of the seed (rule_c = A1 and rule_c = A2) are body_feasible
evaluation.population: 40 individuals (seeds 31001-31040); the two bodies of an individual share the birth state and are not independent; no exclusion
evaluation.pass: number of feasible individuals is strictly greater than half of the individuals (>= 21 of 40)
evaluation.negative_result: a valid attempt with pass = false is a legitimate negative result of the gate, not a failure of the attempt

forbidden_outputs: per-body or pooled counts of A1 and of A2 separately
any proportion of A1 (or A2) among decided windows
any change over windows or time
any difference between the rule_c = A1 and rule_c = A2 bodies
audit_records: layer A: I2 decider records per body
layer B: world intent records per body (delta_id, source_id, created_pulse, action)

validity.rule: if any check fails, the attempt is invalid: no pass/fail is reported and the gate is not satisfied (fail-closed)
checks: the declaration sha256 equals the fixed value in gate.py
number of body rows = individuals x bodies per individual
every body: CT-E10 audit ok (layer A = layer B one-to-one, issued + carried = wins, unique delta ids, log = world)
every body: all declared windows reached and closed (records = windows; decided + tie + none = windows)
every body: no carried-over (unissued) intent at the end (pulses = b_K + L)
validity.invalid_is_not_negative: an invalid attempt is not a negative result and is not rerun on new seeds

one_time_execution.claim: experiments/0038_as2b_forward_gate/attempts/claim-<declaration sha256>.json, created exclusively (O_CREAT | O_EXCL) before the first seed
one_time_execution.refusal: if the claim exists, the gate does not run, whatever --out is
one_time_execution.records_while_running: each body's audit record is written to <out>/records/ as soon as the body finishes; the report is written last
one_time_execution.failure: an exception keeps the claim and writes a failed attempt record with the number of finished bodies; the tool has no override
one_time_execution.restart: only after an independent review that decides without reading the content of partial records; any change to this declaration gives a new sha256 and must be reviewed before running

revised_because: #177 review 5819011204: the two majority criteria were counted on different bodies and on 80 paired bodies instead of 40 individuals
one-time protection depended on --out and on completion
pass could be true when the audit failed
